name: Cooking
desc: Higher cooking skill allows you to learn higher level cooking recipes.  Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.

ranks.name: Journeyman
ranks.desc: Allows a cook to make delicious recipes up to a maximum potential skill of 150.

ranks.name: Expert
ranks.desc: Allows a cook to make mouth watering recipes up to a maximum potential skill of 225.

ranks.name: Artisan
ranks.desc: Allows a cook to make amazing recipes up to a maximum potential skill of 300.

recipes.name: Basic Campfire
recipes.desc: Builds a campfire that increases the spirits of those nearby by 4 and allows cooking.
